name: Terran Federation (WGT / TIF)
description: Unified human empire governed by World Government of Terra and Terran Infantry Forces.

name: Elion Technocracy
description: Ancient civilization master of advanced chemistry and biomechanics, originating from Aqua.

name: Saurian Trade Consortium
description: Nomadic merchants, bankers, and diplomats regulating galactic trade and finance.

name: Drak Remnants
description: Militant splinter faction embracing the Drak Rage through piracy and mercenary fleets.

name: Rebel Empire / Free Alliances
description: Secessionist coalition of independent colonists and defectors opposing Terra's rule.

name: Atronic Threat
description: Renegade cybernetic swarm AI seeking dominance and cosmic transcendence.

name: Great Arakna Swarm
description: Voracious insectoid tide consuming living flesh, biological matter, and metal starships.

name: Gentech Corporation
description: Military-industrial megacorp pioneering fusion weaponry and Mytrion composite armors.
